statement: An attempt whose recorded workspaceBaseCommit does not resolve to a reachable commit is classified by a single typed base-unreachable code at every consumer that reads that field; it is excluded from live replacement, checkpoint, and landing-candidate obligations instead of being pinned by a fail-closed ancestry probe; it never satisfies, substitutes for, or is reported as verification; it does not block recording a fresh attempt at a live base on the same frontier; and where the approved artifact bytes are reproducible from some reachable commit the classification records that reproducibility with its candidate count and never names a substitute base.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
